intent: Choose one of a few visible options in a joined track. role=radiogroup, sm or md, icons optional.
useWhen: Two to five mutually exclusive options that should stay visible, such as billing period or density
A compact switch where each option is a short label, with or without an icon
doNotUseWhen: Switching panels of content — use Tabs
Plans or options that need a description or price — use TileGroup
More than a handful of options — use Select

describedBy.note: Id(s) for aria-describedby on the radiogroup. Field passes its hint or error id.

ariaLabel.note: Names the radiogroup. There is no separate legend.

requirements: role=radiogroup on the root and role=radio on each segment
describedBy lands on the radiogroup as aria-describedby
Roving tabindex: one segment is tabbable
Arrow keys, Home, and End move selection and focus, skipping disabled segments
Disabled segments stay visible and are not selectable

doNot: Do not invent SegmentedControlItem as a separate component
Do not use Tabs variant=segmented when the choice is a form value
Do not ship the group without ariaLabel
snippet: <SegmentedControl ariaLabel="Billing" size="md" defaultValue="month" items={[{ value: 'month', label: 'Monthly' }, { value: 'year', label: 'Yearly', icon: 'CalendarDays' }]} />
